scope: Model specimen 2 (views 2a-2f), including a simple fitted haft; exclude specimen 1.

observed_views.top_2b: Radial flange count and circular socket are visible.
observed_views.rear_2c: Opposite elevation confirms bulb symmetry and flange continuity.
observed_views.shaft_sections_2d_2e: Solid and wrapped/hollow circular sections are documented.

components.construction: one authored central radial body plus one flange repeated around Z, joined only after silhouette validation

bounded_cutoff: Primary head/haft blockout, top/front/isometric comparison, and one correction. No corrosion sculpting, wrapping, UVs or materials before major-form pass.
success_gate: Flange count, radial spacing, bulb profile, socket/finial proportion and haft taper must reach 8/10 in front and top views.
